profile.headline: Software Engineer on the Langley Simulation and Aircraft Technical Services contract
profile.summary: I am skilled in several programming languages: C++, Java, Python. With experience in other languages: PHP, HTML, MySQL. I am a graduate from Old Dominion University with my degree in Computer Science and minor in Computer Engineering. I am currently a contract Software Engineer with Symvionics Inc. on the Langley Simulation and Aircraft Technical Services contract.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Hampton Roads, Virginia Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Design, develop, test, and operate air and space vehicle simulations in object-oriented C++, including graphics programming using OpenSceneGraph and OpenGL.
●	Design, develop, modify, and maintain simulation software using software engineering best practices and standards
●	Participate in design and code reviews, and adhere to existing processes and procedures for full life-cycle software development.

positions.title: Assistant Manager/Senior Guest Adviser
positions.description:
●	Hire and train store staff
●	Review and revise orientation to products and sales training materials
●	Review staff job results and determine the store needs with retail store manager
●	Develop and implement new product training
●	Prepare reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information
●	Maintain high quality service by establishing and enforcing organizational standards
●	Provide excellent customer support by providing technical information on various topics related to gaming and home entertainment

positions.title: Application Support Analyst
positions.locationName: Norfolk City County, Virginia, United States
positions.description:
●	Monitors application and database performance using Precise program
●	Create alerts in Precise to monitor new performance issues as they arise
●	Creates and Analyzes Environment Status Reports for Precise production and development environments
●	Analyzes Database Memory Utilization, Database CPU Utilization, Application Memory Utilization, and Application CPU Utilization reports.
